filters.nodeHint: Show the stock of one location.
filters.onlyInStockHint: Hide rows where nothing is on hand.

empty.text: No stock yet. Record opening balances to start.

check.title: Stock check
check.onHandHint: Total quantity currently held at this location.
check.reservedHint: Quantity already promised to open orders.
check.availableHint: Quantity still free to promise: on hand minus reserved.

check.baseUomHint: Stock is kept in the item base unit.

check.nodeNotFound: This node is not available in the current branch.
check.ambiguousUnit: Multiple units exist for this balance. Choose a unit to check.

opening.title: Opening balance
opening.nodeHint: Active stock location linked to the current branch.
opening.noActiveNodes: No active nodes in this branch
opening.itemHint: Only stock-tracked products can have a balance.
opening.unitHint: The base unit, or a unit with a published conversion.

opening.serialsHint: One serial per line; the count must equal the quantity.

quantityConflict.title: Opening balance already exists
quantityConflict.text: This item already has an opening balance at this node. Use a receipt instead.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.text: Your entered opening balance details will be lost.
